A Gulf day trip to Shell Key Preserve.note: Wayfind's own wf_place_photo row for this place is a NOAA nautical chart (Shell_Key_detail.png), not a photograph of the island, so it does not satisfy "a real photo of that exact place." Commons title search and geosearch around the preserve's coordinates found no actual photograph of Shell Key Preserve. Pass 2 (2026-09-23): Openverse queries 'Shell Key Preserve' (157 results) and 'Shell Key Tierra Verde' (0) surfaced a generic driftwood/beach shot with no geotag or landmark (could be any Gulf beach), a shuttle-dock photo at the Tierra Verde marina (the boat launch, not the preserve itself), and a photo taken from Pass-a-Grille looking across the water toward the preserve (a different beach) — none show the preserve itself closely or distinctively enough to satisfy the exact-place rule.

Parque Amigos de Jose Marti.note: The only Commons photo makes the José Martí statue its subject; US freedom of panorama does not cover sculpture and the statue's own licence is not documented. Needs a photo of the park grounds or the statue's rights confirmed.
